title: The Copper Age
body:
![Mod Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33082c9cea75e55a638e3cbe888fef66cbf434a6.png)

✨ Add Copper to Minecraft 1.16.5! ✨

Dive into a richer, more immersive world with this carefully crafted mod that introduces copper — all designed to enhance your gameplay experience. Perfect for builders, adventurers, and resource collectors alike.

Hours of coding and modeling went into every block and item — so if you enjoy expanding your Minecraft universe, give this mod a try and let the crafting begin!

## 🛠️ Bug Fixes
- Fixed texture glitches for **Copper Ore**, **Copper Ingot**, and **Copper Nugget**
- Corrected sound effects for copper blocks

## 🆕 New Features
- Added full copper toolset:
  - Copper Sword
  - Copper Pickaxe
  - Copper Axe
  - Copper Shovel
  - Copper Hoe
- Added full copper armor set
